units.source_text: 这纯粹是女子纯洁的心灵在呼唤自己男人的声音。

en.t: It was simply the voice of a woman's pure heart calling out to her own man.

units.source_text: 可是她的尖声无疑已响彻整个客栈。

en.t: But her shrill cry had surely echoed through the entire inn.

units.source_text: 岛村有点迷惑，刚想站起身来，女子就用指头戳进纸拉门，抓住格棂，顺势倒在岛村的怀里了。

en.t: Shimamura was somewhat bewildered, and just as he was about to stand up, the woman thrust her fingers through the paper sliding door, seized the lattice, and fell straight into his arms.
